title: Database Tables & Primary Keys
description: Structure tables, define field types, assign primary keys, and build visual queries.

steps.title: What is a Relational Database?
steps.content: Unlike spreadsheets, databases link multiple tables of records using relational keys to eliminate redundant data.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of a Primary Key in an Access table?
options: Uniquely identify every record in the table without duplicates
quiz.explanation: A Primary Key ensures every row in a database table can be uniquely referenced.
